text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka, boasting out-of-this-world speed.
As if inspired by her running...

From the younger generation, Umamusume possessing
speed worthy of a new era were rising rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaaan, I'm gonna
give it my aaaaaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Did you see that, Mama?!

—Special Week.
Silence Suzuka's junior roommate
conquered the Japan Derby.

"And the stage shifts to the Takarazuka Kinen.
—Due to various circumstances, Mejiro Bright
opted out of running, but..."
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, hang in there~! It starts from here!
Even Suzuka-sama in the lead must surely be..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Her speed isn't... dropping?
Not at all...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can do this—just keep going!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka held on for the win! Breathtaking
speed! Not a single rival could even catch her shadow!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A truly out-of-this-world runaway lead! Whether it's a GⅠ or a GⅡ, she blows them away completely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa......
The result was—a landslide victory for Silence Suzuka.

Even Mejiro Dober couldn't catch up,
and Mejiro Bright was left speechless by such an unconventional run. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Suzuka... Congratulations~.
That was a magnificent run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Have we ever seen a race like this before?
No, we have not~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "I have not. And for me... it is a style of running that the Mejiro family cannot do..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Suzuka, so that is
the true you~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, Bright... It's thanks to you that I was able to discover my own way of running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh, mine...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because back during that Derby,
you showed me a run
that only you could ever deliver.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I came to truly believe from the bottom of my heart
that I want to run a race that is uniquely my own."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The person I was on that day wasn't the real me,
but today…… is the real me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not complete yet.
When I can truly reach beyond the scenery...”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
There, without a doubt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that... so? In that case, I must shine even brighter than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As we are now, it won't reach. And just as the scenery
beyond your sight lies even further ahead~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our Mejiro ideals
still lie further ahead—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Suzuka-sama,
would you run with me this time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before, I may have been the one to give you your start.
However, today, it was you who taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going. I can deliver a run
far more worthy of the Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That is why... it has to be the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes—it's a promise.

"Inspiring each other and awakening one another, the two
head toward the place of their reunion. And then—"
The Tenno Sho (Autumn). Feeling that something momentous might happen once we give it our absolute all, we must make every possible preparation for that day.
